tools.name: fastbill_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (name, address, e-mail, VAT id, payment terms and bank details as stored in FastBill). Filter by search term (organization, name, address, zip, e-mail or tags), customer number, country or city. customer.get.

tools.name: fastbill_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by FastBill customer id. customer.get with CUSTOMER_ID.

tools.name: fastbill_list_contacts
tools.description: List contact persons of customers (name, position, e-mail, phone). Filter by customer, search term or contact id. contact.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_invoices
tools.description: List outgoing invoices, drafts and credit notes with totals, state (draft, unpaid, overdue, paid, canceled), dates and line items. Filter by customer, number, type, date ranges (invoice date, due date, paid date, last update). invoice.get.

tools.name: fastbill_get_invoice
tools.description: One invoice by FastBill invoice id, with all line items, VAT, payments and the document URL. invoice.get with INVOICE_ID.

tools.name: fastbill_list_recurring_invoices
tools.description: List recurring invoice templates (customer, interval data, totals, items). recurring.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates (quotes) with state (a created, b sent, c negotiation, d accepted, e rejected, f invoiced), totals and items. estimate.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_expenses
tools.description: List expense entries (supplier, category, net/VAT/gross, dates, document URL). Filter by invoice number or date ranges. expense.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_revenues
tools.description: List revenue entries (income booked in FastBill: customer, totals, dates, payments). Takes the same filters as invoices. revenue.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_articles
tools.description: List products and services (article number, type, title, unit price, VAT, unit). article.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (name, customer, hourly rate, VAT, start/end date). project.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_time_entries
tools.description: List work time entries (customer, project, date, minutes, billable minutes, comment, invoice). Without filters FastBill returns the latest entries of the current month. time.get.

tools.name: fastbill_list_templates
tools.description: List the invoice/estimate templates (template id, name, hash). Use a template id with the create tools. Ids change whenever a template is edited. template.get.

tools.name: fastbill_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer. customer_type is required; a business needs organization, a consumer needs last_name. Bank details are not accepted by this tool. FastBill does not check for duplicates, so search with fastbill_list_customers first. customer.create.

tools.name: fastbill_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: update fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass change. Bank details are not accepted by this tool. customer.update.

tools.name: fastbill_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create an invoice for a customer from line items. FastBill stores it as a draft; it gets its number and becomes final only with fastbill_complete_invoice, and it is never sent by this tool. Check the result with fastbill_get_invoice. invoice.create.

tools.name: fastbill_complete_invoice
tools.description: WRITE, NOT REVERSIBLE: turn a draft invoice into a final invoice. FastBill assigns the invoice number and PDF; a final invoice can no longer be edited (it can only be canceled in FastBill). Nothing is sent to the customer. Only call this after the user confirmed the draft. invoice.complete.

tools.name: fastbill_set_invoice_paid
tools.description: WRITE: mark a final invoice as paid, with the payment date and method. invoice.setpaid.

tools.name: fastbill_create_estimate
tools.description: WRITE: create an estimate (quote) for a customer from line items. It is not sent. estimate.create.

tools.name: fastbill_create_article
tools.description: WRITE: create a product or service (article number, title and unit price are required). article.create.

tools.name: fastbill_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project for a customer (name and customer are required). project.create.

tools.name: fastbill_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: book a work time entry on a project (customer, project and start time are required). time.create.
